metadata.Name: JParaCrawl
metadata.Description: JParaCrawl is a large-scale English-Japanese parallel corpus constructed by broadly crawling the web and automatically aligning parallel sentences. It contains over 8.7 million sentence pairs and covers a broad range of domains.
metadata.Paper Title: JParaCrawl: A Large Scale Web-Based English-Japanese Parallel Corpus
metadata.Venue Title: Proceedings of The 12th Language Resources and Evaluation Conference
Affiliations: NTT Communication Science Laboratories, NTT Corporation
